POR.text: Holiday is the second current Trail Blazer to crack the NBA’s all-time scoring top 100—Damian Lillard currently ranks 37th on the list (22,945 points).
One of six players in NBA currently averaging 24+ ppg, 6+ apg and 6+ rpg; only to do so on .500+ FG% / .400+ 3FG%.
Has recorded 10+ rebs in eight straight games; has eight pts/rebs double-doubles this season—t-7th most in NBA.
Avdija is shooting 55.3% on drives this season—11th in the league among players with at least 80 driving field goal attempts.

Coming off the bench in every game so far this season, Jrue Holiday ranks highly in several bench categories: Total Bench Points 239 pts (1st); Assists 76 asts (2nd); Field Goals Made 81 FGM (1st); 3-Pointers Made 42 3PM (t-1st); Steals 22 stls (2nd).
Leads the NBA in contested rebound percentage (59.4%).
Since entering starting lineup (8 games): 9.9 ppg / .446 FG% / .410 3FG%.
Has started 103 consecutive regular season games.
Portland’s strength of schedule and strength of record currently rank top five in the NBA according to ESPN’s RPI metrics: Strength of Schedule .554 (4th).

Portland also ranks top 10 in the NBA in total, offensive and defensive rebounding percentage: Total Rebounding Percentage 52.4% (6th); Def. Rebounding Percentage 70.3% (6th); Off. Rebounding Percentage 33.6% (9th).

Coming off a season in which he ranked top five in the NBA in contested shots, blocks, offensive rebounds and total rebounds Donovan Clingan again ranks highly in those categories: Blocks Per Game 2.1 bpg (t-3rd); Contested Shots Per Game 11.2 (2nd); Block Percentage 7.6% (3rd); Rebounds Per Game 11.5 rpg (5th); Offensive Rebounds Per Game 3.8 orpg (3rd); Total Rebounding Percentage 23.9% (1st).

In addition to offensive improvement, the Trail Blazers’ defense has shown growth as well—leading Portland to a top 10 net rating: Net Rating 6.4 (7th), from -0.4 (19th); Offensive Rating 116.8 (7th), from 113.1 (21st); Defensive Rating 110.4 (7th), from 113.5 (12th).

Though early in the season, Jrue Holiday has been efficient from beyond the arc—ranking highly in 3-point percentage and catch and shoot 3-point percentage: 3-Point Percentage 44.2% (5th); C&S 3-Point Percentage 45.7% (23rd).
